stories.title: ‘I’ll be back’: vows Kane after ankle surgery, Premier League resumes: football news – matchday live
stories.body: We provided all the buildup to today’s games as the Premier League returns after the international break An email has hit my inbox ‘re the lack of fancy Dan wingers', from Patrick Morgan: I don’t think you’re talking nonsense, but I’d say it’s tactical rather than a lack of talent. Look at Arsenal. Calafiori, Timber and White either bomb on or tuck into midfield, so the wide player has to work more like a No 8, working the half-space and tracking back, rather than being the classic ‘star man’ left high and wide to beat his full-back. Saka is the exception because he does both. A lot of Arsenal’s dynamism doesn’t come from out wide at all. It comes from Declan Rice driving through the middle like a very mobile siege engine. The 2015–2020 lot were mostly given licence to stay forward and decide games, and fewer managers allow that now. It works, but it can make Arsenal a bit stodgy to watch. That being said, I’d instantly forgive Sánchez and take him back over our other options. 60 goals in 120-odd league games, and he could knock out a number on the piano. Phwoar. Continue reading...
